name: com.xengine.genshin
description: Genshin-style anime (NPR) character rendering (ramp shading, SDF face shadow, rim light, inverted-hull outline) plus a basic third-person combat demo with a 5-hit combo. Official optional package: listed in Package Manager, not mounted until installed. Sample character assets are converted from a private reference project for internal testing only and must not be redistributed.

samples.description: KeQing toon character (ramp body/hair, SDF face shadow, outline) with WASD movement, sprint, jump, and a 5-hit sword combo against training dummies with hit-stop and camera shake.
